standard_prerequisites: Henselianity of the pair (A, I_n) for I_n the kernel of A -> A_n
The scheme theoretic support of a finitely presented module as a closed subspace
The stage-wise identification of the support after base change to A_n from the finitely presented lemma of the situation
The henselian split-off lemma writing a closed subspace as a disjoint union of an open and closed part proper over the base and a part disjoint from the closed fibre
core_obligations: Fix n >= 1 with I_n the kernel of A -> A_n; the pair (A, I_n) is henselian by the limit henselian lemma

Let Z be the scheme theoretic support of F, a closed subspace since F is of finite presentation, and by part three of the finitely presented lemma Z x Spec(A_n) equals the support of F_n, hence is proper over Spec(A/I_n)

The henselian split-off lemma writes Z = Z_1 disjoint union Z_2 with Z_1 and Z_2 open and closed in Z, Z_1 proper over A, and Z_1 x Spec(A/I_n) the support of F_n; equivalently |Z_2| does not meet X_0
Replacing W by W minus Z_2 makes the support of F proper over A
proof_roadmap: Fix a level n and use henselianity of (A, I_n)
Identify the support after base change via the finitely presented lemma
Split off the proper part with the henselian lemma and shrink W by the complement
